recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, stylized graphic emblem featuring a red bird with outstretched wings connected by a vertical line to a red heart at the bottom, set against a grainy, sand-colored background with a thin double-line border.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the bird and the heart
High contrast between the deep red icons and the tan textured field
Geometric alignment of typography at the extreme top and bottom margins
Linear connection between the avian and cardiac symbols
coreInvariants: Speckled, cork-like or sandy background texture
Double-stroke outline around the central red shapes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bird-heart emblem is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red phoenix with its wide horizontal wingspan acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bird, follows the vertical line down to the heart, then moves to the wide-set text at the top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space around the central icon, emphasized by the uniform texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy saturation with a focus on mid-tones to simulate aged paper or natural materials.
paletteRestrictions: No bright primary blues or greens

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain formal symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic transitional serif look and high contrast.
Provides the elegant, sharp serifs and traditional feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square composition with a grainy, sand-colored texture. In the center, place a symmetrical red phoenix with its wings spread, connected by a thin vertical line to a red heart below it. The red shapes should have a thin cream-colored double outline. Add a thin double-line border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text at the very top and very bottom margins. The text should be dark charcoal and have extremely wide letter spacing so it spans the full width of the inner border.

verificationChecks: Is the bird-heart icon perfectly centered?
Is the background texture visible and consistent?
Is the typography set in all-caps with extreme tracking?
Are the red icons outlined in a lighter cream color?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical line perfectly bisects the heart and bird.
Check that the text does not touch the central graphic.
Verify the double-line border is clean and parallel to the edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central symmetrical folk-art icon with a grainy earth-tone background and wide-tracked serif typography at the margins to evoke a 1970s singer-songwriter aesthetic.
